put.description:
Replace the canonical context with the submitted sections.

Omitted fields become explicitly unknown: this is a full replacement, so a
founder never keeps a claim they just removed.

post.description:
Preview the caption and tracking link a manual post will receive.

Read-only: nothing is persisted and no provider is called. It reuses the
exact helpers the create path uses, so the operator sees the real caption
instead of a client-side approximation that could drift.
Schedule a finalized manual post through its configured publisher.

Queue a provider schedule so Cloudflare's ~125s edge timeout cannot
turn a completed provider call into an ambiguous 524 response.
Create a provider draft. Buffer supports this; the webhook does not.
Ask the configured publisher for the fate of every saved provider post.

get.description: Named Buffer accounts configured in g3.env (keys never leave the server).
Read one saved Buffer post's provider state and optional personal-key metrics.

post.description:
Ask Buffer for the fate of every scheduled post ID and persist the verdict.

Manual and explicit: nothing here schedules, drafts, or publishes. The
local ``buffer_status`` is left untouched — this records what the provider
says next to it, so "scheduled (our record)" and "sent (their word)" can
never be confused. Only an explicit ``sent`` counts as sent.
Plan the first market-validation experiment. Nothing is executed.

Accepts an optional founder hint (method/channel) recorded in provenance.
Hints are requests Hermes may decline with reasons; ungovernable methods

get.description: Canonical automation name for reading the latest plan.

Everything the business has told or shown us, in one place.

Read-only and transparent: this is exactly what the account, workflow,
and campaign suggesters see, so a recommendation can always be traced
back to the evidence behind it. Unknown slots stay unknown.

schema.title: Response Read Evidence Company Automation Evidence Get

post.description:
Rank the next governed runs from evidence. Advisory only.

Deterministic: the same evidence always yields the same ranking. Nothing
is generated, governed, approved, or run here — each recommendation names
the method to plan with, when it is due, how long to give it, and the
expected range with its basis.

schema.title: Response Suggest Next Runs Company Automation Suggest Post

get.description: The latest governance decision and the lifecycle it has reached.

post.description:
Validate a plan and, only if governance allows it, create the workflow.

A blocked plan is still persisted with its reasons and creates no workflow,
so a refusal is auditable rather than a silent no-op.
Record the founder's approval. Execution stays locked until this exists.

Run the approved workflow through the existing runner.

Governance may authorize ``simulate_outreach`` (rehearses, touches nothing)
or ``draft_outreach`` (writes local drafts the founder sends by hand).
Neither reaches an external system, and the approved limits are re-checked
here — a cap tightened after approval still governs this run.

get.description: All governed workflows, newest first, each with its engine document.

Read-only and deterministic: the best accounts (customers, else engaged,

get.description:
World-data predictions for this company's industry. Read-only.

An explicit `industry` overrides the resolved one (for pages reasoning
about a planned market); otherwise the industry
resolves from the founder's own stored data (validated ICP first, else
top evidence industry). With nothing stored the general-B2B band applies
and says so. Every figure carries sources and vintage, and recorded
results elsewhere always take precedence over these bands.

pool does not exist yet, so nothing here is transmitted anywhere — this
is the contribution contract, and the opt-in flag below governs it.

get.description:
Free verification state for a prospect company. Read-only, no writes.

GLEIF is looked up live (free, keyless); web presence and enriched
profiles come from local stores only. A miss in any source is reported,
never filled — the calibration UI renders it as an honest badge.
Validate dashboard Basic credentials without reading a product domain.

schema.title: Response List Workflows Company Workflows Get

post.description:
Founder action: offer slots to the contact by email. The request is
always recorded; the email is attempted after and its failure is reported
honestly without losing the record (same pattern as enrichment).

Founder action: mirror recent Resend received emails into inbound replies.

Covers everything the ``email.received`` webhook missed while it was
unconfigured or down — Resend stores inbound mail regardless. Writes go
through the exact ingest path the webhook uses, so a re-sync is a no-op
duplicate rather than a second reply; senders that match no lead are
reported as unmatched instead of being silently dropped.

get.description:
Everything an external form tool needs, on one screen.

The endpoint URL is built from COMPANY_PUBLIC_URL (the address the tool
must reach), not the browser origin: the founder may be viewing the
dashboard on a LAN address the outside world cannot use. The secret is
only ever read from the environment — there is no other copy of it.

schema.title: Response Intake Config Company Commercial Forms Config Get

post.description:
Shared submission endpoint for external form tools.

Accepts JSON ({"form": "contact", "answers": {...}}, a flat object of
answers, or a flat object with a "form" key) or form-encoded bodies.
Known keys map onto the lead record; everything else is kept as clean
answers on the inbound interaction.
